timing_contract: Causal10ms block means sampled100Hz from source1000Hz sequence. At block end t, predict the10ms block ending t+100ms. Every feature uses blocks ending at or before t.
calibration: No target calibration from held run; preceding five seconds of its force waveform supply causal period and history. Known treadmill speed is permitted.
independent_unit: Entire speed run within one participant; only two development runs and one faster reserved run

reference.equation: C; F=current plate1 force(N), v=2*(F-F_t-50ms), a=F-2*F_t-50ms+F_t-100ms, C=past-cycle target phase force, vO=2*(opposite-opposite_t-50ms). Coefficients dimensionless except stated flexible response coefficients N.

baseline_persistence.equation: F; F=current plate1 force(N), v=2*(F-F_t-50ms), a=F-2*F_t-50ms+F_t-100ms, C=past-cycle target phase force, vO=2*(opposite-opposite_t-50ms). Coefficients dimensionless except stated flexible response coefficients N.

baseline_velocity.equation: F+v; F=current plate1 force(N), v=2*(F-F_t-50ms), a=F-2*F_t-50ms+F_t-100ms, C=past-cycle target phase force, vO=2*(opposite-opposite_t-50ms). Coefficients dimensionless except stated flexible response coefficients N.

baseline_periodic.equation: C; F=current plate1 force(N), v=2*(F-F_t-50ms), a=F-2*F_t-50ms+F_t-100ms, C=past-cycle target phase force, vO=2*(opposite-opposite_t-50ms). Coefficients dimensionless except stated flexible response coefficients N.

baseline_flexible.equation: F+b0+sum_j b_j exp(-mean((z-center_j)^2)/2); F=current plate1 force(N), v=2*(F-F_t-50ms), a=F-2*F_t-50ms+F_t-100ms, C=past-cycle target phase force, vO=2*(opposite-opposite_t-50ms). Coefficients dimensionless except stated flexible response coefficients N.

attempt_001_damped.equation: F+b0*v+b1*a; F=current plate1 force(N), v=2*(F-F_t-50ms), a=F-2*F_t-50ms+F_t-100ms, C=past-cycle target phase force, vO=2*(opposite-opposite_t-50ms). Coefficients dimensionless except stated flexible response coefficients N.

attempt_002_phase.equation: F+b0*(C-F)+b1*v; F=current plate1 force(N), v=2*(F-F_t-50ms), a=F-2*F_t-50ms+F_t-100ms, C=past-cycle target phase force, vO=2*(opposite-opposite_t-50ms). Coefficients dimensionless except stated flexible response coefficients N.

attempt_003_bilateral.equation: F+b0*v+b1*a+b2*vO; F=current plate1 force(N), v=2*(F-F_t-50ms), a=F-2*F_t-50ms+F_t-100ms, C=past-cycle target phase force, vO=2*(opposite-opposite_t-50ms). Coefficients dimensionless except stated flexible response coefficients N.

attempt_004_stance.equation: F+b0*v+b1*a+b2*v*tanh(F/100N)+b3*a*tanh(F/100N); F=current plate1 force(N), v=2*(F-F_t-50ms), a=F-2*F_t-50ms+F_t-100ms, C=past-cycle target phase force, vO=2*(opposite-opposite_t-50ms). Coefficients dimensionless except stated flexible response coefficients N.

attempt_005_phase_bilateral.equation: F+b0*(C-F)+b1*v+b2*vO; F=current plate1 force(N), v=2*(F-F_t-50ms), a=F-2*F_t-50ms+F_t-100ms, C=past-cycle target phase force, vO=2*(opposite-opposite_t-50ms). Coefficients dimensionless except stated flexible response coefficients N.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Show every group and matched-baseline difference. Few groups/dates do not justify narrow population confidence intervals; no row bootstrap.

scope_limits: One participant, three treadmill speeds; no independent-person generalization. Force-platform channels are signed and the source timing columns are unusable.

exposure.historical_record: Public source-aware corpus; internally reserved confirmation opened only after candidate/selection/stopping freeze. Outcomes now exposed to future users. This is computational confirmation, not independent experimental replication.

scope: One middle eligible forecast origin from every native recording/session with at least one eligible origin; all currently exposed partitions covered.
native_prefix_audit.limits: Released-product prefix invariance at tested origins; not a proof of publisher upstream processing causality or every possible mutation.
